photo.credit: NASA · Langley Research Center reduced-gravity walking simulator (1963). Apollo crews trained for lunar gait by being suspended at a 9.5° angle, simulating 1/6 g. Half a century later, the same problem — predicting how the human body moves in unfamiliar gravity — still drives ground-training architecture.
